## Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Reproduction Steps
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to '...'
2. Run '...'
3. See error

## Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened instead. Include error messages, stack traces, or unexpected output.

## Environment
- Node.js version: (e.g., v20.0.0)
- npm version: (e.g., 10.0.0)
- OS: (e.g., Ubuntu 22.04, macOS 13.5, Windows 11)
- Project type: (e.g., r-script, package, shiny)

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here. Attach logs, code snippets, or test cases if relevant.

## Possible Solution
If you have any ideas on how to fix this, describe them here (optional).

## Checklist
- [ ] I've searched for existing issues with similar problems
- [ ] I've provided clear reproduction steps
- [ ] I've included relevant error messages or logs
- [ ] I've specified my environment (Node/npm versions, OS)
